keyVerseDR: "In your patience you shall possess your souls." (Lk 21:19)

level1.title: Don't Be Afraid
level1.story: People admired the beautiful Temple. Jesus said one day it would fall. He said, "Do not be afraid. Not a hair of your head will be lost."
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What did Jesus say not to be?
When do you need to be brave?

activity.title: Picture sudoku
activity.intro: Each row and column has each picture once.

level2.title: Stand Firm
level2.story: Some people were talking about the Temple, adorned with goodly stones and gifts. Jesus said, "The days will come in which there shall not be left a stone upon a stone." He said there would be wars, earthquakes, and signs, and His followers would be persecuted. But He promised to give them words and wisdom. Jesus said, "But a hair of your head shall not perish. In your patience you shall possess your souls."
level2.keyLine: In your patience you shall possess your souls.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did Jesus warn about hard times?
How can patience protect your soul?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me persevere in faith. Amen.

activity.title: A brave saint
activity.intro: Jesus' friends were brave when times were hard. Write about a saint you want to be like.
starters: I want to be like this saint by...
